These books are a value and treasure greater than a college education in comparative mythology and religious studies ever could be. Give yourself the keys of discernment. Listen to Spirit Whirled.

recA5BnM5umys9yRk.Body: Kyle and Serena Denton are community herbalists creating wild-crafted and organic plant medicines out of Milwaukee since 2015. I have used their teas and tinctures on an almost daily basis for years now. Kyle is a great friend of InnerVerse and has appeared on the channel more times than I can count. These products work, not in the allopathic "pharma-medicine" way, but in a terrain-support, consciousness bolstering plant-teacher sort of way.
recA5BnM5umys9yRk.Name: Tippecanoe Herbs
recA5BnM5umys9yRk.Offer Line: Use coupon code "innerverse" at checkout for a 10% discount!

recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.
recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Name: The Sonic Slider

recFdBmTf1pJJOP6S.Body: LotusWei provides amazing and transformative plant essence elixirs, using one of nature's most gentle and beautiful elements: the flowers themselves. Led by founder Katie Hess, LotusWei supports customers with diverse products that operate on homeopathic principles and energetic resonances. I use LotusWei Elixirs to give me an edge with psychic & energetic sensitivity, discernment, and life force coherence. In other words, LotusWei Elixirs help me be a better podcaster and Biofield Tuner. Benefits accumulate over long term use!
recFdBmTf1pJJOP6S.Name: LotusWei Flower Elixirs

He has appeared on InnerVerse multiple times to talk about hydrogen as a macronutrient and EZ water.

recMVdJjP2VZJyI2m.Body: Clive de Carle has spent decades researching high-quality natural health essentials, from magnesium and fulvic minerals to iodine, selenium, and vegan-sourced vitamin D. His supplements are formulated with a focus on bioavailability, so the body can actually absorb and use what you're taking rather than letting it pass through unused. It's a simple, no-nonsense approach to filling the nutritional gaps most modern diets leave behind.
recMVdJjP2VZJyI2m.Name: Clive de Carle

rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Bio: Chance Garton is the host and producer of the Innerverse Podcast, where for over a decade he has investigated consciousness, mythology, symbolism, terrain health, and the psychosomatic language of the human body and mind. A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Name: Chance Garton
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Role: Host of the Innerverse Podcast, biofield tuning practitioner & researcher

recQOLj1bGHrs7YCW.Bio: Michelle Lundquist describes herself as a folk herbalist, gardener and homemaker with a passion for plants and their ability to heal. She has studied and actively worked with herbs since 2013, drawing most of her knowledge from hands on experience and mentors of the wise woman tradition, and a do it yourself spirit runs through her work as she encourages people to take their wellbeing into their own hands. She hosted more than eighty episodes of The Healing Home podcast as a kitchen witch, homemaker and folk herbalist, and now co-hosts Symbolic Studies with her husband Mario Garza.
recQOLj1bGHrs7YCW.Name: Michelle Lundquist

reckIvJxU4wRhybxA.Bio: Mario Garza is the artist and researcher behind Symbolic Studies, a project sharing symbolic insights on the zodiac, mythology, folklore and world religions, with astrology as its foundation. A lifelong artist who has worked as an art director and graphic designer for nearly 25 years, he runs Symbolic Studies from the Pacific Northwest alongside his wife Michelle, who co-hosts the podcast with him. His work traces syncretic threads across tarot, occultism and comparative religion, including the argument that the major deities of antiquity were originally polar gods before a solar model was laid over them. He also offers symbolic birth chart and tarot readings, private lessons and freelance design.
reckIvJxU4wRhybxA.Name: Mario Garza

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Structured water and the ouroboros worldview", "body": "Michelle Lundquist describes urine as structured water that carries a person's own thoughts and history, which she says makes every moment an act of programming the water she will later drink. Chance Garton explains why he chose the Auryn from The Neverending Story for the episode art, contrasting a mainstream picture of a universe winding down into entropy with a cyclical one where life feeds on its own returns. He points to the water cycle, the Fremen stillsuits of Dune, and the way he invokes the body's own intelligence in every biofield tuning session as signs that what comes from us may also restore us."}, {"title": "Gold, the sun and serpent symbolism", "body": "Mario Garza opens the slides with a list of golden things in nature, from honey and pollen to egg yolks and ghee, and Michelle Lundquist adds that many of them are prized for their nutrient density. Mario cites Rene Guenon's claim that gold was once seen as mineral light that could not be owned. Chance Garton links gold to the solar plexus and kidneys, traces Hebrew and Greek words that tie the serpent to the eye, and offers wordplay linking urine with gold, the sun and a golden river, framing sunlight as a purifier and healer."}, {"title": "Kidneys, fear and the blood connection", "body": "Michelle Lundquist draws on traditional Chinese medicine to argue that the kidneys, linked with fear, produce the very medicine needed to transmute that fear, and she cites a viewer's view that urine therapy was the first homeopathy. She describes urine as filtered blood plasma and says the practice has made her far more aware of what she eats. Mario Garza speculates, by his own admission without certainty, about urine as a positive form of consuming one's own blood, tying the idea to Holy Grail myths and the grail as a symbol of one's own center."}, {"title": "Shiva's instructions and a private practice", "body": "Reading from The Golden Fountain, Mario Garza walks through verses attributed to Shiva in the Damar Tantra: the vessels the practice calls for, taking only the middle of the stream because the mouth and tail of the serpent hold poison, and the instruction to keep the practice secret. He argues it is a sacred, private communion rather than something to perform for an audience. Michelle Lundquist shares her habit of letting morning urine rest before drinking it, and the guests read the verses on conquering the elements as learning to balance them. Chance Garton notes that secret and secrete share a sound."}, {"title": "Alchemy, Temperance and the decision to heal", "body": "Mario Garza decodes the alchemical glyph for urine as a sacred center within nested layers, like a holy of holies, and calls the practice primordial or polar medicine. Michelle Lundquist reads the symbol as a reminder that healing is always the individual's own decision, a point Chance Garton expands into the idea that half-hearted action goes nowhere. Mario connects the Temperance card, vitriol, Sagittarius and Chiron to the hunter theme, and Chance adds the arrow as compass. In the viewer questions, Michelle and Mario suggest starting small, diluting topical use during pregnancy, and going slowly with aged urine."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Vibe Rant regular favorites Michelle Lundquist and Mario Garza return! This power couple combine holistic wisdom with Michelle's Healing Home with mythological analysis on Symbolic Studies, and in this episode, our friends are here to discuss the human health ouroboros, the waters of our life. Is Shivambu legit? Proverbs 5:15: "Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well."
fields.Quotes JSON: [{"text": "It's structured to you and by you and for you, and that has been one of the biggest mindblowers for me, because what it makes me realize and what it makes me really remember is that every single moment of every single day I'm structuring my water that I'm going to consume.", "author": "Michelle Lundquist", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/bff9a941-de38-45a1-a6e9-4e4dcece050e/MICHELLE-LUNDQUIST.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "This whole thing is the snake eating its own tail, that life requires death for life to continue, and so you begin to look at the things that you might have considered to have been the decay or the decrepit with a different light.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Every tuning I do, I think part of what makes it effective is that I specifically invoke the intelligence of my body and the intelligence of the person who I'm working with, their body, and I ask: please just guide this process. Let the intelligence of our bodies be what directs us through this whole thing.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Your apprehension to doing it or your acceptance of doing it is going to say a lot about where you're at with your own personal self-acceptance.", "author": "Mario Garza", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/94a2fe35-cc60-4591-8931-7e2b7af18c82/MARIO-GARZA.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "The most basic evidence that you're having some sort of spiritual expansion or your consciousness is widening is that you're going to be more sensitive. You're going to feel things more powerfully.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "The kidneys are associated with fear, but they are the actual thing that produces the medicine you need to conquer those fears, or to understand the fears, or to tap into those fears that you're having so that you can transmute it.", "author": "Michelle Lundquist", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/bff9a941-de38-45a1-a6e9-4e4dcece050e/MICHELLE-LUNDQUIST.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "The Holy Grail exists at the symbolic center of all that is, but the Holy Grail is also at the center of yourself, right? It's kind of like finding your true essence or your true core.", "author": "Mario Garza", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/94a2fe35-cc60-4591-8931-7e2b7af18c82/MARIO-GARZA.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Once again it just makes me think, if the original divine nectar is actually your own urine of all things, right, what a complete inversion that is if that's the case.", "author": "Mario Garza", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/94a2fe35-cc60-4591-8931-7e2b7af18c82/MARIO-GARZA.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "It's going to be up to you if you really want to do that. You can have all the modalities in the world, you can buy all the sessions, you can go to all the doctors, but if you're not ready, and you're not ready to commit to the healing...", "author": "Michelle Lundquist", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/bff9a941-de38-45a1-a6e9-4e4dcece050e/MICHELLE-LUNDQUIST.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "The most important thing in the process of healing or regenerating or finding balance is the decision to do it, the real concrete decision to do it, because you can take all kinds of actions half-heartedly and they won't get you anywhere.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "This medicine is literally coming from within you, and so I've been kind of referring to it as, just internally between us, as primordial medicine or even polar medicine. It's coming from that central pole.", "author": "Mario Garza", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/94a2fe35-cc60-4591-8931-7e2b7af18c82/MARIO-GARZA.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "It really is like this complete circle, this complete loop of kind of proving the things that we've been talking about the whole time, that the answers lie within, and these waters are sacred. Waters are a huge part of the equation to the healing that we can all achieve.", "author": "Michelle Lundquist", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/bff9a941-de38-45a1-a6e9-4e4dcece050e/MICHELLE-LUNDQUIST.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}]
